title: Copy destination register
statement: For a Boolean nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, the copy-identifier type has the constructors $A,B,Q1s,Cap,Q2,N1,Tn,E,Ts,F,Tw,U,Q1f,E2,Ts2,F2,Tw2,U2,Q1f2,Tpos,Q3,Q4,Q1a,Q2a,Uc,Tsc$. The destination-register map sends these, respectively, to $r_A,r_B,r_{Q1},r_{Cap},r_{Q2},r_{N1},r_T,r_E,r_T,r_F,r_T,r_U,r_{Q1},r_{E2},r_T,r_{F2},r_T,r_U,r_{Q1},r_T,r_{Q3},r_{Q4},r_{Q1},r_{Q2},r_U,r_T$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a Boolean nondeterministic Turing machine
